newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers not well established, few sales steady to firm, USDA said.
Inquiry fair, demand rather light. Sales confirmed on 1,800 slaughter steers and 1,100 slaughter heifers Thursday.
For the week to date 94,200 head confirmed including 18,100 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 66.50.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 980 lbs 66.00.
